title: Publicly-Detectable Watermarking for Language Models

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.2: "we use zero-shot prompting of GPT-4 Turbo [Ope23]" to rate text-completion quality 0-100; Figure 2 aggregates these judge scores per protocol

prompt.location: Sec 4.2: "our prompt template asks the model to: (a) rate the text completion ... 0 (worst) to 100 (best), and (b) give reasoning ... in list form"
prompt.note: This is the judge prompt for scoring watermarking-protocol outputs; GPT-4 Turbo is not the text-generation subject (Mistral-7B/Llama-2 are).

claim.metric: GPT-4 Turbo quality score (0-100), by protocol
claim.location: Figure 2 (bar chart only): "the mean score falls between 27 and 40 for all protocols"; 250 prompt completions per bar

data.source: C4 dataset (news-like subset) prompts; code at github.com/jfairoze/publicly-detectable-watermark

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is the auxiliary judge, not the paper's studied system (Mistral 7B / Llama 2 generate the watermarked text). Only a chart and a text range (27-40) are given; no exact per-protocol mean is printed.
